title: Zesty Fried Chinese Rice Yangzhou Fried Rice
description: A light, jammy, Ayurveda-rajasic-friendly take on traditional Yangzhou fried rice, featuring a tandoor-smoked flavor and crunchy mustard seeds. Serve as a date-night dish, perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Tandoor-smoked chicken breast
ingredients.notes: Slice into thin strips before using

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: For frying the rice and chicken

ingredients.name: Mustard seeds
ingredients.notes: Brown or black, toasted in a pan before adding to the rice

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the toasted mustard seeds and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced chicken breast and cook until browned, about 4 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the diced scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), salt, and black pepper, and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the rice is well combined and heated through.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter and garnish with additional scallions, if desired.
